properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail
properties.query:
// Covers ConsoleSignin (RAM/root account console logon) and Login (CloudSSO directory
// authentication) events only. LoginToAccount (CloudSSO account/role selection, no fresh
// credential check) and STS AssumeRole/AssumeRoleWithOIDC (role assumption, overwhelmingly
// automated/service traffic) are out of scope for Authentication.
let vimAuthenticationAlibabaCloudActionTrail = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , srchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]) // SrcHostname is not populated by this source
    , username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , targetappname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresult: string = '*'
    , eventresultdetails_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    AliCloudActionTrailLogs_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where eventName in ("ConsoleSignin", "Login")
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | extend
        _ErrorCode = trim(@'"', errorCode)
        , _TargetUsername = tostring(userIdentity.userName)
        , _TargetAppName = case(
            serviceName in ("AasSub", "AasCustomer"), "Alibaba Cloud Console"
            , serviceName == "CloudSSO", "CloudSSO"
            , serviceName
        )
    | extend
        _EventResult = iff(isempty(_ErrorCode) and isempty(errorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
        , _EventResultDetails = case(
            isempty(_ErrorCode) and isempty(errorMessage), ""
            , _ErrorCode == "Authentication.Failed", "Incorrect password"
            , _ErrorCode == "AuthenticationFailed.UsernameOrPassword", "No such user or password"
            , "Other"
        )
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(sourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(sourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0 // SrcHostname not available in source
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or _TargetUsername has_any (username_has_any)
    | where array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0 or _TargetAppName has_any (targetappname_has_any)
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or "Logon" in (eventtype_in)
    | where eventresult == '*' or eventresult == _EventResult
    | where array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0 or _EventResultDetails in (eventresultdetails_in)
    | extend
        _UserIdentityType = tostring(userIdentity.type)
        , _TargetUserId = tostring(userIdentity.principalId)
        , _MfaAuthenticated = tostring(userIdentity.sessionContext.attributes.mfaAuthenticated)
        // ConsoleSignin == additionalEventData.loginType
        // Login (CloudSSO) == requestParameters.LoginMethod
        , _LoginMethodRaw = case(
            isnotempty(tostring(additionalEventData.loginType)), tostring(additionalEventData.loginType)
            , isnotempty(tostring(requestParameters.LoginMethod)), tostring(requestParameters.LoginMethod)
            , ""
        )
        // sourceIpAddress can also hold a hostname (e.g. cloudmonitor.aliyuncs.com)
        , _SrcIsIp = ipv4_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0") or ipv6_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "::/0")
        , _DvcHasDomain = eventSource has "."
        , _SuspiciousLogin = tostring(additionalEventData.suspiciousLogin)
    | extend
        EventCount = int(1)
        , EventStartTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventEndTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventVendor = "Alibaba Cloud"
        , EventProduct = "ActionTrail"
        , EventSchema = "Authentication"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , EventType = "Logon"
        , EventSubType = "Interactive"
        , EventResult = _EventResult
        , EventResultDetails = _EventResultDetails
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = case(isnotempty(_ErrorCode), _ErrorCode, isnotempty(errorMessage), errorMessage, "")
        , EventMessage = errorMessage
        , EventSeverity = iff(isnotempty(_ErrorCode) or isnotempty(errorMessage), "Low", "Informational")
        , EventOriginalSubType = eventCategory
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , LogonMethod = iff(_MfaAuthenticated == "true", "Multi factor authentication", "Other")
        , LogonProtocol = "HTTPS"
        , Dvc = case(isnotempty(eventSource), eventSource, isnotempty(serviceName), serviceName, "ActionTrail")
        , DvcFQDN = iff(_DvcHasDomain, eventSource, "")
        , DvcHostname = iff(_DvcHasDomain, tostring(split(eventSource, ".")[0]), "")
        , DvcDomain = iff(_DvcHasDomain, substring(eventSource, indexof(eventSource, ".") + 1), "")
        , DvcDomainType = iff(_DvcHasDomain, "FQDN", "")
        // assumed-role principalId/userName are "<roleId-or-roleName>:<sessionName>"
        // sessionName identifies the human who assumed the role.
        , TargetUserId = iff(_UserIdentityType == "assumed-role", tostring(split(_TargetUserId, ":")[0]), _TargetUserId)
        , TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(_TargetUserId), "Other", "")
        , TargetUsername = iff(_UserIdentityType == "assumed-role", tostring(split(_TargetUsername, ":")[-1]), _TargetUsername)
        , TargetUserType = case(
            _UserIdentityType == "root-account", "Admin"
            , _UserIdentityType in ("ram-user", "cloudsso-user", "saml-user", "oidc-user", "assumed-role"), "Regular"
            , "Other"
        )
        , TargetOriginalUserType = _UserIdentityType
        , TargetUserScopeId = tostring(userIdentity.accountId)
        , TargetAppName = _TargetAppName
        , TargetAppType = iff(isnotempty(serviceName), "Service", "")
        , SrcIpAddr = iff(_SrcIsIp, sourceIpAddress, "")
        , SrcFQDN = iff(not(_SrcIsIp) and sourceIpAddress has ".", sourceIpAddress, "")
        , TargetRiskLevel = toint(case(_SuspiciousLogin == "true", 100, _SuspiciousLogin == "false", 0, int(null)))
        , TargetOriginalRiskLevel = _SuspiciousLogin
    | extend
        Application = TargetAppName
        , LogonTarget = TargetAppName
        , Dst = TargetAppName
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , Src = SrcIpAddr
        , User = iff(isnotempty(TargetUsername), TargetUsername, TargetUserId)
        , TargetUsernameType = case(isempty(TargetUsername), "", TargetUsername has "@", "UPN", "Simple")
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalUid = eventId
        , EventOriginalType = eventName
        , EventProductVersion = eventVersion
        , HttpUserAgent = userAgent
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , pack(
                "eventType", eventType
                , "loginMethodRaw", _LoginMethodRaw
                , "mfaChecked", tostring(additionalEventData.mfaChecked)
                , "isMFAChecked", tostring(additionalEventData.isMFAChecked)
                , "mfaAuthenticatedRequestParam", tostring(requestParameters.MFAAuthenticated)
                , "loginAccount", tostring(additionalEventData.loginAccount)
                , "serviceName", serviceName
                , "requestId", requestId
                , "acsRegion", acsRegion
                , "isGlobal", isGlobal
                , "additionalEventData", additionalEventData
                , "requestParameters", requestParameters
            )
            , dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , EventCount
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventSeverity
        , EventProduct
        , EventVendor
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventUid
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventMessage
        , EventProductVersion
        , Dvc
        , DvcFQDN
        , DvcHostname
        , DvcDomain
        , DvcDomainType
        , LogonMethod
        , LogonProtocol
        , LogonTarget
        , TargetUserId
        , TargetUserIdType
        , TargetUsername
        , TargetUsernameType
        , TargetUserType
        , TargetOriginalUserType
        , TargetUserScopeId
        , TargetRiskLevel
        , TargetOriginalRiskLevel
        , TargetAppName
        , TargetAppType
        , Application
        , SrcIpAddr
        , SrcFQDN
        , Src
        , Dst
        , IpAddr
        , User
        , HttpUserAgent
        , AdditionalFields
        , Type
};
vimAuthenticationAlibabaCloudActionTrail(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    srchostname_has_any=srchostname_has_any,
    username_has_any=username_has_any,
    targetappname_has_any=targetappname_has_any,
    eventtype_in=eventtype_in,
    eventresult=eventresult,
    eventresultdetails_in=eventresultdetails_in,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack)
